generation.targeted_retry_reason: The first result read partly as a scraped surface channel with honey droplets; the final targeted revision changed only that material behavior to a shallow continuous subsurface bloom.

visual_qa.inspection_method: view_image at original detail after final generation

checks.criterion: Continuous warm mineral-ivory yogurt field with broad negative space
checks.note: The field is full-bleed, warm ivory, quiet, and unbounded; most of the frame remains low-activity space.

checks.criterion: Amber-green ingredient character emerges from beneath the field
checks.note: A low-contrast amber zone with sparse thyme micro-fibers reads at shallow mixed depths and dissolves on every side.

checks.criterion: Controlled infusion rather than garnish, splash, pour, fold, or fully mixed marbling
checks.note: The final revision removes surface droplets and the scraped-channel cue; the ingredient zone behaves as capillary subsurface diffusion.

checks.criterion: Hybrid photographic ingredient truth plus minimal matte graphic field
checks.note: Yogurt grain and botanical fibers remain materially legible while the overall composition stays minimal and matte.

checks.criterion: No people, product, typography, logo, whole herb, object cutout, bounded photo, tabletop, or horizon
checks.note: None of the prohibited representational objects or text elements are present.
Mineral ivory dominates, with pale honey amber and sparse muted thyme green under one soft directional source; no crushed black or dramatic ray.

checks.criterion: Natural asymmetry and no uniform CGI gloss
checks.note: The bloom is irregular and off-center with subtle density variation; there is no synthetic shine or jelly volume.

unresolved_risks: Because the bloom is intentionally very low contrast, some compressed or low-brightness presentations may reduce the visibility of the thyme fibers.
The concept image communicates material behavior directionally and should not be treated as a literal prediction of production-batch appearance.

evidence_boundary: Directional ambient concept visual only; not evidence of a production recipe, SOP, sensory panel, or finished food appearance.
